thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: High 5xx error rate spike on dedicated-us-east GPU pool (routing: enterprise-routing/v2). Spike started ~13:22 UTC. Alert: <https://alerts.redwood.example/ALRT-8721> Sev: high. Pager target: oncall-ryan.

oncall-ryan: Ack. I see many `502`/`523` from pool nodes. Paging @sre-elaine for infra.

sre-elaine: I'm on it. Initial triage: connection resets from shard redwood-dedicated-01 -> likely node NIC flapping. Starting rolling restarts for pool nodes (cmd: `./ops/restart-pool --pool=dedicated-us-east --grace=30s`). ETA ~10m.

acct-mgr-jordan: Which enterprise customers are affected? Need tailored comms for Ursa Financial and Meridian Health.

sre-elaine: Quick scan of routing logs -> affected customer routes: Ursa Financial (enterprise-urn-001), Meridian Health (enterprise-mer-004), NovaPay (enterprise-nov-032), Helix Payments (enterprise-hel-009), Vectra AI (enterprise-vct-021). Traffic was partially routed to fallback model variants; some requests still returned 5xx. Estimated share of failing requests from Ursa ~18% of total failing traffic.

customer-success-tess: Drafting notification for Ursa. Proposed subject: "Redwood Inference — Partial service degradation (US-East)"

customer-success-tess: Draft email body (please review):

```
Hi <Ursa PM>,

We're reaching out to let you know that between 13:22 and 13:41 UTC today, some inference requests routed to your dedicated pool in us-east returned 5xx errors. We detected the spike, automatically routed most traffic to fallback models, and performed a rolling restart of affected nodes. Estimated impacted sessions: ~0.6% of Ursa's inference volume during the window. No data was exposed; requests either succeeded or returned an error.

Actions taken:
- Rolling restart of affected nodes completed by 13:41 UTC.
- Health checks passed; error rate trending to baseline.
- Follow-up: kernel/NIC driver update scheduled in maintenance to prevent recurrence.

We will share a postmortem once the root cause is finalized. If you want immediate details or a call, please let us know and we'll arrange one.

Sincerely,
Redwood Customer Success
```

pm-omar: We should include a short status page blurb and estimated ETA to full recovery. Avoid overpromising.

sre-elaine: Update: restart finished on 6/7 nodes, error rate down from 4.7% -> 0.5% and continuing to drop. Running extended health checks for 30m before final clear. ETA to full recovery ~20-30m.

oncall-ryan: handing off to night coverage. @support-luis can you take watch at 14:05 UTC? I'll summarize handoff below and leave monitoring queries. :white_check_mark: 

support-luis: I’ll pick up at 14:05 UTC. Please add runbook links and current logs to the incident thread. I’ll post the status page update and send the tailored Ursa email once approvals are in place.

acct-mgr-jordan: Add legal-security and Ursa security contact to CC. Also include primary account contacts and phone numbers in outreach:
- Ursa PM: mariela@ursa.example / +1-555-0142
- Ursa Infra: ops-team@ursa.example / +1-555-0199

customer-success-tess: Tailored one-liner for status page and Ursa notice: "Impact: Some inference requests routed to Ursa Financial's dedicated pool in US-East returned 5xx errors between 13:22–13:41 UTC. Most traffic was auto-rerouted to fallback models; a small fraction of requests may have failed. Estimated affected requests: ~0.6% of Ursa's volume during the window."

pm-omar: Approved. Add small note for urgent customers: "If this outage caused degraded UX or business-critical failures, reply and we'll prioritize a dedicated RCA call."

sre-elaine: Quick internal ops note for postmortem: cause likely NIC driver instability on node-03 causing TCP resets -> kernel + driver patch planned. Tagging eng-infra to schedule maintenance and validation.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Error rate trending to baseline, rolling restart complete. Monitoring window started 13:41 UTC.

support-luis: Status page draft (to publish in 5m):

```
Status: Degraded — Partial service degradation in US-East affecting enterprise routing (resolved)
Impact: Some customers experienced increased 5xx errors for inference requests between 13:22–13:41 UTC. Most traffic was rerouted to fallback handlers; a small subset experienced failures.
Customers: Ursa Financial, Meridian Health, NovaPay, Helix Payments, Vectra AI (partial)
Mitigation: Rolling restart of affected nodes completed; monitoring shows error rates returning to baseline. Post-incident maintenance planned.
```

acct-mgr-jordan: Please ensure the Ursa email CCs are included. After publishing, I’ll send the exec briefing to Ursa leadership.

oncall-maya: noted for oncall rotation. Will watch the monitor overnight.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED at 13:48 UTC — Error rate returned to baseline and nodes passed health checks. Follow-ups: postmortem + customer outreach (email, optional call). :white_check_mark: :tada:

sre-elaine: After-action items: 1) Schedule kernel/NIC driver update on affected pool (eng-infra). 2) Add additional healthcheck on TCP resets threshold. 3) Confirm fallback model capacity for peak-third-party routing. I'll file the postmortem ticket and link here.

pm-omar: Thanks all. Good templated comms. Keep the Ursa outreach tight and CC legal.

acct-mgr-jordan: Sending final note to Ursa now. Will attach logs and incident timeline.

customer-success-tess: Posted email to draft folder and added URSA CCs. Will send after legal thumbs-up. :thumbsup:

support-luis: I'll keep watches and escalate if any regression.

incident-bot: Thread closed (auto) — monitoring continues under active incident watch for 30m.
